svg.text: Layer 1 - electronics tray
front of car ->
1. velcro under the bank (3.5 mm pair) | held by: adhesive both
sides | ports:
2. velcro under the holder (3.5 mm pair) | held by: adhesive both
sides | ports:
3. battery bank (Pi power) | held by: velcro + 18 mm bank fence,
open at the rear | ports: -x: USB-C at the -y rear corner, USB-A
at the +y rear corner; charge button on the -y side ~10 mm
forward of the rear end (fence open x < 15); charge LEDs on top
near the -y side, ~10-40 mm from the rear end (read from the
side)
4. 2S holder + 2x Samsung 25R | held by: velcro + 4-sided 14 mm
fence on its lobe | ports: -x: red / black leads + MB wire, 160
mm, from a SHORT end (Evan 2026-10-14) - seat that end at -x; MB
55 mm from the brass rivet on the +x end
5. velcro under the fuse holder (3.5 mm pair) | held by: adhesive
both sides | ports:
6. inline fuse holder, 3 A ATO (50 x 34.25 x 12, lying flat) | held
by: velcro on top of the bank | ports: in the CELL+ wire, before
the BMS
7. velcro under the BMS (3.5 mm pair) | held by: adhesive both sides
| ports:
8. 2S BMS (ACEIRMC B08HLQQCQJ) | held by: velcro on top of the 2S
holder | ports: +x: pads toward the rivet end (MB wire 55 mm); P+
/ P- 4 x 190 mm over the bank to the -y lobe
9. velcro under the charger (3.5 mm pair) | held by: adhesive both
sides | ports:
10. USB-C 2S charger (Adeept p0374) | held by: velcro | ports: -y:
USB-C out the -y lobe edge; BAT / GND pads at the +y end
11. velcro under the XT30 (3.5 mm pair) | held by: adhesive both
sides | ports:
12. XT30 pair, mated (25 x 10.5 x 5.3) | held by: velcro (pack half)
| ports: +x: pack half (BMS P+/P-, soldered); car half -x to the
rocker
13. bank USB-C plug | held by: keep clear | ports:
14. bank USB-C cable along the bank's -y side (below its top, off
the LED strip) | held by: keep clear | ports:
15. bank USB-C cable rise past the wing's front end | held by: keep
clear | ports:
16. P+/P- crossing over the bank | held by: keep clear | ports:
17. charger USB-C plug | held by: keep clear | ports:
18. XT30 unplug room | held by: keep clear | ports:
19. holder lead exit | held by: keep clear | ports:
20. holder MB rivet end | held by: keep clear | ports:
Layer 2 - electronics deck
front of car ->
1. velcro under the Pi case (3.5 mm pair) | held by: adhesive both
sides | ports:
2. Raspberry Pi 5 in Vilros case | held by: velcro + brackets: +x
end legs 4 mm, +y side legs, -y side leg at the -x corner (ports
clear) | ports: +x: camera opening (mid-face); -y side: USB-C 7
mm from the +x end; -x: USB-A + LAN (4 mm from the sides)
3. Arduino Uno R3 + proto shield (TB6612, caps, divider) | held by:
4 standoffs + pegs | ports: -y: USB-B (overhangs 7.3) + DC jack
(4.1); jack positions NOT measured
4. USB-B plug clearance (16 x 30 x 13 allowance, plug NOT measured)
| held by: hangs from the Uno jack | ports: -y: to the Pi
5. LM2596 buck, 5.00 V (display) | held by: 4 standoffs + pegs |
ports: display up; trim pot locked
6. rocker switch (20 mm round) | held by: snap-in 21 mm hole on the
-y wing | ports: body hangs 23.8 below the wing (to z 30.7)
7. rocker body below the -y wing (clips 22.9, depth 23.8) | held by:
snap-in 21 mm hole | ports:
8. Pi USB-A / LAN plugs | held by: keep clear | ports:
9. Pi front camera ribbon | held by: keep clear | ports:
10. Pi USB-C plug (-y side, 7 mm from the +x end) | held by: keep
clear | ports:
11. Pi fan / top access | held by: keep clear | ports:
12. Uno shield wiring | held by: keep clear | ports:
13. LM2596 terminals -x | held by: keep clear | ports:
14. LM2596 terminals +x | held by: keep clear | ports:
15. rocker terminals | held by: keep clear | ports:
